franklin.name: Franklin
franklin.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Franklin had 3.3 months of supply, which is a seller's market, down from 4.1 three months earlier and up from 2.6 a year earlier. The median sale price was $860,000, unchanged at 0.0% from a year earlier, and homes had a median of 43 days on market. Active listings numbered 533, up 4% from a year earlier.

brentwood.name: Brentwood
brentwood.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Brentwood had 3.8 months of supply, which is a seller's market, down from 6.0 three months earlier and 4.0 a year earlier. The median sale price was $1,425,000, up 16.3% from a year earlier, and homes sold at an average of 97.6% of list price. Median days on market was 50, compared with 55 a year earlier, with 302 active listings.

spring-hill.name: Spring Hill
spring-hill.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Spring Hill had 4.0 months of supply, a balanced market, down from 5.1 three months earlier and up slightly from 3.9 a year ago. The median sale price was $559,990, up 4.5% from a year earlier, with homes selling at an average of 99.1% of list price. Median days on market was 57, compared with 58 a year earlier, and active listings stood at 406.

nolensville.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Nolensville has 2.9 months of supply, which falls in seller's market territory and is down from 6.5 months three months earlier and 5.0 a year earlier.
